implementation_constraints: Pure stdlib (json, sys) — no external dependencies
Reads entire stdin as single JSON object, processes atomically
Exits 0 with single output line (JSON or 'ERROR')

unresolved_intent.rationale: Type (A-Z) and key (a-z) validation use direct membership checks rather than regex or isupper/islower to ensure deterministic, version-agnostic behavior and avoid Unicode classification surprises.
Spec allows empty values ('key='). The split/join operations preserve empty strings perfectly in both encode and decode, satisfying AC-PA-04 round-trip requirement without special casing.

Any malformed frame or message causes the entire batch to fail with exactly 'ERROR'. No partial output. This ensures INV-PA-ATOMIC-01 — batch processing is all-or-nothing; atomicity is stronger than per-message error reporting.

JSON parsing errors, type errors, and runtime exceptions all map to 'ERROR' for the batch. This provides robustness without silently hiding bugs; the caller learns the input was malformed but not the internal reason (which is correct for a sandboxed codec).
